items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, I know he played with Joe Jones' band, Wilbert Hogan. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Wilbert Hogan.

ctx.x: Okay. Edwin Hogan, yeah. Edwin Hogan. And he was almost like a little genius as far as I was concerned. I mean he could play and sing. He had a group that used to sing under the stars over there in a square out there. He always kept something going. He won all kind of awards for his brother. He played drums.
Oh, I know he played with Joe Jones' band, Wilbert Hogan.

Yeah, Wilbert Hogan. Yeah, well they had a bunch of musicians came out this city man, I can't remember all of them. And from time to time I'd meet one here and meet one and you know run into all kinds. I remember one time the union had some kind of squabble or something going on, Joe Jones and whatever it was going on. I played with Curtis Trevino, he played guitar. That boy played, he left here and went to California and did good for himself playing drums.
